title: Ceasefire-period toll reaches 1,613 killed; 20 killed in past week
detail: Gaza Health Ministry figures reported Nov 9-10, 2026: at least 1,613 Palestinians killed and 5,833 wounded since the Oct 2025 ceasefire, and a cumulative 74,643 killed and 175,962 wounded since Oct 2023. Al Jazeera counts 20 killed over the past week. Gulf News reports four killed in three strikes in Gaza City and one shot dead after crossing the Yellow Line in Khan Younis; the IDF said it struck militants in Gaza City. Figures do not distinguish combatants from civilians.
